Job Title: Commercial Product Manager EMEA (m/f/d) - Remote
Company: TE Connectivity
Posting Start Date: 7/31/26
Source: careered.io (mode:full), tag: Product Manager

Job Overview
The Commercial Product Manager EMEA (m/f/d) will be responsible for the
Industrial Communications portfolio across the EMEA region, driving product
strategy, commercialization, and go-to-market execution for a broad range of
industrial connectivity solutions.

Job Requirements
- Own and manage the regional EMEA product strategy for the Industrial
  Communication Portfolio
- Drive go-to-market strategies and commercial product management activities to
  accelerate market adoption and revenue growth across EMEA
- Collaborate across engineering, sales and marketing to align the roadmap
- Analyze market trends, competitive landscape and customer requirements
- Define pricing strategy and manage product lifecycle

(Захвачено частично через браузер — текст обрезан фильтром расширения на
~1600 символов. Полная версия подтянется штатным ingest-клиентом по Bearer.
Используется как фикстура для демонстрации движка подгонки резюме.)
